definitionBean.title: Graphical and Algebraic Methods
definitionBean.definition: Methods to solve a pair of linear equations including substitution, elimination, and graphical representation.
definitionBean.explanation: Linear equations can be solved algebraically using substitution or elimination methods, or graphically by finding intersection points of lines.

parts.statement:
Solve the following pair of linear equations by the Substitution Method:
7x - 15y = 2
x + 2y = 3
parts.explanation:
Equation (1): 7x - 15y = 2
Equation (2): x + 2y = 3

From equation (2), express x in terms of y:
x = 3 - 2y  --(Equation 3)

Substitute this value of x into equation (1):
7(3 - 2y) - 15y = 2
21 - 14y - 15y = 2
21 - 29y = 2
-29y = 2 - 21
-29y = -19
y = 19/29

Substitute y into equation (3):
x = 3 - 2(19/29)
x = 3 - 38/29 = (87 - 38) / 29 = 49/29

Therefore, x = 49/29 and y = 19/29.

parts.statement:
Solve using the Substitution Method:
s - t = 3
s/3 + t/2 = 6
parts.explanation:
Equation (1): s - t = 3 => s = t + 3
Equation (2): s/3 + t/2 = 6

Substitute s into equation (2):
(t + 3)/3 + t/2 = 6
[2(t + 3) + 3t] / 6 = 6
2t + 6 + 3t = 36
5t + 6 = 36
5t = 30 => t = 6

Substitute t back into s = t + 3:
s = 6 + 3 = 9

Therefore, s = 9 and t = 6.
